verdict.rationale: Gemini documents its own Connected Apps feature: it can connect to other apps, take actions in them with permission, and work with Google Calendar or third-party apps for productivity tasks. The evidence never shows a browsable directory or marketplace of third-party apps and connectors, nor a documented flow for adding them, and Connected Apps does not work in Google Messages. missing for 10: a browsable third-party app/connector directory, a documented add/install flow for third-party connectors, a list of supported third-party apps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
